task: Read kernel_src/EXPERIMENT_CONTEXT.md before planning. Expand the existing gfx12x HIP/rocWMMA FP8 block-scaled GEMM from native M=1,2 to a comprehensive native M=1..16 implementation. M=4 is the production-weighted performance target, but a candidate is invalid unless every integer M from 1 through 16 uses one native HIP device dispatch for all supported N,K multiples of 128; do not win by exact M=4 or exact Qwen N/K routing, and do not silently fall back to Triton. Preserve the exact FP32-per-128-K scaled-partial accumulation contract, BF16 output, captured padded B strides, fresh output storage, and current inputs on every call. No weight preshuffle, persistent weight/output buffers, memoization, extra device dispatch, AITER, CK, or FlyDSL. Protect current M=1,2 performance at 0.98x per Qwen case; require every expansion and portability case to stay at least 0.98x versus the live hybrid baseline; require at least 1.01x on the production-weighted M=4 ratio-of-sums. Test all 112 manifest cases with five random draws and row-distinct/rank-pattern inputs. Prefer a compact M<=16 HIP kernel family based on wave packing, N-tile width, K split, and occupancy rather than an exact-shape table. Before promotion, prove HIP engagement, run three cache-flushed reversed-order paired passes, CUDA-graph replay, and a full Qwen TP A/B with NCCL_PROTO=Simple fixed in both legs.

op_spec.implementation: native HIP/rocWMMA skinny FP8 block-scaled GEMM
